name: FMCats Georgia 2023

venue.name: Private Residence
venue.details: Exact address will be emailed to registered competitors before the competition

information:
This competition is a special competition with **only 3x3 Fewest Moves, 4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5 Blindfolded, and 3x3 Multi-Blindfolded**; we will not be holding any standard speedsolving events. If you are a first-time competitor and are interested in competed in regular events like 3x3, you may want to look into [Cuber Jackets Fall 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CuberJacketsFall2023).

This competition will have three cats roaming around the venue.

Only one guest per competitor is permitted. Please consider coming without a guest if possible as spectator seating will be limited due to the competition being held at a private residence.
